about: The place outcomes people can hear about: each is a kept outcome of the outcome web that another engine reads (the file that reads it is named), with the subject its story is about. A month's record names every one of these that moved; the press decides what to print. A heard story is a known fact, and what reads it (the electorate's town conditions) cites the story. A story about a moved condition argues no change of its own, so each reader it reaches takes it as a reason for the side their own view already holds on the policy question or budget line its subject ties to (`questions`, by subject), by the views engine's heard-event amount (owner, Oct 22, 2026).

economy.question: budget-line:incomeSecurity
economy.why: Unemployment rising is the case for or against spending on the jobless: unemployment insurance and other income support are the income-security line.

crime.question: budget-line:police
crime.why: Crime rising is the case for or against spending on the police, the line voters tie most to crime.

housing.question: us-policy-positions:housing-land-use.rent-stabilization
housing.why: Rent rising is the case for or against rent stabilization, the housing question voters tie most to rent.

lived.about: Event kinds that are a person living one of these conditions themselves, by the subject they live: the people the event names take it as a reason for the side their own view already holds on that subject's question, as a reader of a story about it does.
